The Feathers Fly Part II#103.dst: 嘿小鬼。接见，是吧？嘿嘿嘿……我倒是有个主意……
The Feathers Fly Part II#103.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#104.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.dst: 你知道吗，要拿到接见很难……超——级难……不过我知道一个办法。
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#105.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.dst: 真的很简单很简单……你只要交给我 [{~} 绿宝石块]，我就帮你搞定！
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#106.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#106.dst: ……嘿嘿嘿……好吧，要是你有意思，你知道上哪找我！
The Feathers Fly Part II#106.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#107.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.dst: 所以你找到那个怪贩子了？你该不会在想……
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#108.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#108.dst: 我是说……其实，那确实是个能拿到接见的办法。他要什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#108.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#109.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.dst: [{~} 绿宝石块]？那很多吗？我又不是人类，你知道吧！好啦，总之！
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#110.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.dst: 你想买就买吧，不过我确定还有其他办法能拿到接见。你不是非买不可。
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#111.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#111.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#112.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.dst: 哎呀谢谢你！跟你做生意真愉快，嘿嘿……祝你好运！
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#114.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.dst: 说真的，你们这些人到底怎么回事！就不能让我清静五分钟吗？！
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#115.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.dst: 哦不好——意思，是有人叫你来这里的吗？你要来“惊艳”我吗？
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#116.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#116.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#117.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.dst: 等你真的有什么有意思的东西再来吧。再见。
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#118.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.dst: 哦？你除了找到那个贩子，还找到另一个争取接见的办法？
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#119.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.dst: [{~} 绿宝石块]，是吗？不知道那算不算多。我觉得我们该试试你说的另一条路！是什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#120.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.dst: 有专门负责接见的接待员？真方便！那我们该去找她谈谈！
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#121.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Oh... Well, that's not helpful. Maybe we can still give it a go?
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.dst: 这……据说非常难？哦……嗯，那没什么帮助。也许我们还是可以试试？
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#122.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.dst: 你想跟那个怪贩子买也行，不过我们也该去见见那个接待员。想要我跟你一起去就说一声。
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#123.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.dst: 好，那我们走吧。我觉得我们该避开那个贩子，我绝对不想跟法律作对！
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#124.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.dst: 所以，那个贩子就在里面，是吧？我们继续往前走吧。避开那个地方。
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#125.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.dst: 等等等等，我刚才不是才跟你说——我就缩小一点……
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#126.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.dst: 欸，[{~} 绿宝石块]，一分都不能少！别担心，我可以让你们两个都拿到接见！你女伴挺害羞的嘛！相信我，我懂你的辛苦！
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#127.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#127.dst: 哎呀谢谢你！跟你做生意真愉快，嘿嘿……祝你好运！
The Feathers Fly Part II#127.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#130.src: And just WHO are you two, busting here like that?
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.dst: 你们两个到底是谁，就这样闯进来？
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#131.src: Uh... Greetings... We've heard that we should come here for-
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.dst: 呃……你好……我们听说应该来这里——
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#132.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? Shouldn't you be working at that time?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.dst: 你们有任何东西可以展示吗？这个时间你们不是该在工作吗？！
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#133.src: No, it's just that I, well... Nevermind, I do have a thing to show, it's, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.dst: 不，只是我，嗯……算了，我确实有东西要展示，就是，呃……
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#134.src: Not ANOTHER word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.dst: 别再说了！我听够了！你们两个显然没有值得我花时间的东西！
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#135.src: Go back to your minimum wage job or something, but stay OUT of my room.
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.dst: 回去做你们领最低工资的工作之类的吧，但别再进我的房间。
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#136.src: The citizens said it was hard, huh? No kidding. Maybe we should've had something before strolling in.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.dst: 市民们说很难，是吧？可不是嘛。也许我们该先准备好东西再晃进去。
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#137.src: Look, we'll figure out another approach. This can't end here! We need an audience invitation letter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.dst: 听着，我们会想出别的办法。不能就这样结束！我们需要一封接见邀请函。
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#138.src: I'll head back to the town center, so if you want to talk I'll see ya there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.dst: 我回市中心那边，所以如果你想聊，我们那里见！
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#139.src: That certainly didn't go well. But keep your head up! We got this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.dst: 那确实不太顺利。不过打起精神！我们做得到！
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#140.src: There was a normal way to get an audience which is via a competition. We... missed it. So that'll have to pass.
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.dst: 原本有个正规的争取接见途径，就是参加比赛。我们……错过了。所以那个只能放弃了。
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#141.src: Now, for other... Unconventional ways... There was some panic by the Armour Merchant earlier today.
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.dst: 至于其他……比较不正规的办法……今天稍早防具商人那边有人在慌张。
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#142.src: Check it out if you want, I won't cause trouble. I'd rather be the friendly neighbourhood mechanic!
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.dst: 你想的话就去看看，我不会惹麻烦的。我宁愿当个友善的邻家技师！
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#143.src: There is apparently a dealer in the castle the receptionist's in, first entrance to the left. However, he charges emeralds...
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.dst: 据说接待员所在的那座城堡里有个贩子，左手边第一个入口。不过，他要收绿宝石……
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#144.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.dst: 我相信我们能找到免费的办法。就靠你了！想要我跟你一起去就说一声！
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#145.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.dst: 希望这次能成功。你带路，我跟着！
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#146.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.dst: 哦，拜托别在我面前提“接见”这个词！
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#147.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#147.dst: 我、我的邀请函刚被偷了！真不敢相信！
The Feathers Fly Part II#147.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#148.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.dst: 我四处问过了，显然没人知道任何事！我正在找……
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#149.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.dst: 这间旅馆已经整修好一阵子了……是藏赃物的好地方！
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#150.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.dst: 可是不——，当然锁起来了！不过看起来可以从后面进去……
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#151.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.dst: 那边好像有条可疑的小巷……也许……
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#152.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.dst: 呃，抱歉唠叨这么多。我根本不认识你。我相信那边有条通道……
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#153.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're onto something but I'd rather not do anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around at the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.dst: 等等等等，我相信你发现了什么，不过我不想在城里做什么可疑的事。你想怎么做随你，我会在市中心附近晃。
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#154.dst: 哦，拜托别在我面前提“接见”这个词！

The Feathers Fly Part II#161.dst: 等等等等，我相信你发现了什么，不过我不想在城里做什么可疑的事。你想怎么做随你，我会在市中心附近晃。
The Feathers Fly Part II#161.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#162.src: Let's hope we don't get rejected this time around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#162.dst: 希望这次别再被拒绝了。
The Feathers Fly Part II#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#163.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#163.dst: 所以，那个贩子就在里面，是吧？我们继续往前走吧。避开那个地方。
The Feathers Fly Part II#163.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#164.src: Oh god, not another duo. What do you want?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#164.dst: 天啊，又来一对。你们想干嘛？！
The Feathers Fly Part II#164.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#165.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.dst: 哦，呃，你好！我们有东西要给你！
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#166.src: And what would a mechanic have for- Wait, is that an invitation letter..?
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.dst: 一个技师能有什么给——等等，那是邀请函吗……？
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#167.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.dst: 这……前所未有。我查查议会什么时候有空，帮你们预约接见……
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#168.src: You two are extremely lucky. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.dst: 你们两个运气好得不得了。我简直不敢相信。
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#169.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.dst: 希望明天早上你们方便，因为议会不知道为什么刚好那时候有空。
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#170.src: Sounds good? Hopefully it does, because you don't really have much of a choice. Well, you can leave now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.dst: 可以吗？最好可以，因为你们其实也没什么选择。好了，你们可以走了。
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#171.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.dst: 真不敢相信我们真的有进展了！太令人兴奋了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#172.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.dst: 好，接见之前我们得先测试一下机器。我做了些调整！
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#173.src: Meet me near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just go by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.dst: 想搭便车就到北边入口附近找我。或者，如果你喜欢走路，也可以直接去工坊！
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#175.src: So, how do I find help...
The Feathers Fly Part II#175.dst: 那么，我要怎么找人帮忙……
The Feathers Fly Part II#175.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#176.src: I sure do love... Money. Totally!
The Feathers Fly Part II#176.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#177.dst: 哦，嘿！我打听到一些东西了！！
The Feathers Fly Part II#177.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#178.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#178.dst: 好，这不太合法，但是据说……
The Feathers Fly Part II#178.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#179.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#179.dst: 有个……可疑的贩子，可以跟他买接见邀请函？
The Feathers Fly Part II#179.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#180.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#180.dst: 我相信还有别的办法，不过那家伙应该在东边的城堡里，左手边第一扇门。
The Feathers Fly Part II#180.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#181.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#181.dst: 你自己看着办吧。我想我就……继续打听。
The Feathers Fly Part II#181.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#182.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#182.dst: 接见？哦，原来你也是那种人……
The Feathers Fly Part II#182.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#183.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#183.dst: 对对，穿过那边那座城堡，就能找到接待员。
The Feathers Fly Part II#183.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#184.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#184.dst: 你拿到的机会可是微乎其微。从别人手上偷邀请函还比较有希望，嘿！
The Feathers Fly Part II#184.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#185.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#185.dst: 说到这个……我想一个小时前城的另一头还真发生过这种事。
The Feathers Fly Part II#185.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#186.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#186.dst: 也许你可以帮帮那个弄丢邀请函的人。也许你可以把它偷来。我又管不着你！好了，快走！别踩到我的植物！
The Feathers Fly Part II#186.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#188.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#188.dst: 我是说，对，谁都可以试着争取……
The Feathers Fly Part II#188.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#189.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#189.dst: 不过你得非常出色才行。我是说，我不想刻薄，但你不够格。
The Feathers Fly Part II#189.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#190.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#190.dst: 如果你真的想去，接待员在城堡里。一直往东走别停。
The Feathers Fly Part II#190.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#191.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#191.dst: 不过我跟你说，那么多疯疯癫癫的家伙跑进去，她的心情从来没好过。
The Feathers Fly Part II#191.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#192.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#192.dst: 哦，你好。在找什么？……接见？什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#192.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#193.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#193.dst: 呃……让我猜猜你的机器是什么。是武器吗？它射什么？沙子？
The Feathers Fly Part II#193.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#194.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#194.dst: 抱歉，只是有点烦。如果你真的想要接见，有个接待员专门负责。
The Feathers Fly Part II#194.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#195.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#195.dst: 问问别人吧。这种事找我没用。
The Feathers Fly Part II#195.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#196.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#196.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#197.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#197.dst: 我一直在打造世界上最伟大的机器人化剑！
The Feathers Fly Part II#197.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#198.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#198.dst: 听着，你得去找接待员，把她惊艳得不得了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#198.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#199.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#199.dst: 太棒了！最坏的情况你会死，但只要运气够好，就只会断一条手臂！
The Feathers Fly Part II#199.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#200.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#200.dst: 她在东边的城堡里，一直穿过去往前走，总会走到的！
The Feathers Fly Part II#200.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#201.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#201.dst: 嘿，怎么了？我确实打听到一些东西！
The Feathers Fly Part II#201.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#202.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#202.dst: 嗯……所以我们可以去找接待员，她也许会给我们接见机会。明白了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#202.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#203.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#203.dst: 所以我们进去，让她看看我们有多厉害，我想这样就行了，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part II#203.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#204.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#204.dst: 没关系，我相信你只要让她看到你的决心之类的就行。
The Feathers Fly Part II#204.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#205.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#205.dst: 哦，对，我也打听到一些东西！
The Feathers Fly Part II#205.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#206.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#206.dst: 据说有个可疑的家伙在卖接见邀请函！
The Feathers Fly Part II#206.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#207.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#207.dst: 我记得是在东边的城堡里，左手边第一个？不过……
The Feathers Fly Part II#207.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#208.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#208.dst: 我相信还有别的办法。比如那个接待员！所以她在城堡最里面的房间，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part II#208.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#209.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#209.dst: 其实，如果你想要我跟你一起去，我也可以！跟我说一声就好！
The Feathers Fly Part II#209.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#211.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#211.dst: 嘿小鬼。接见，是吧？嘿嘿嘿……我倒是有个主意……
The Feathers Fly Part II#211.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#212.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#212.dst: 你知道吗，要拿到接见很难……超——级难……不过我知道一个办法。
The Feathers Fly Part II#212.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#213.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#213.dst: 真的很简单很简单……你只要交给我 [{~} 绿宝石块]，我就帮你搞定！
The Feathers Fly Part II#213.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#214.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#214.dst: ……嘿嘿嘿……好吧，要是你有意思，你知道上哪找我！
The Feathers Fly Part II#214.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#215.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#215.dst: 所以你找到那个怪贩子了？你该不会在想……
The Feathers Fly Part II#215.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#216.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#216.dst: 我是说……其实，那确实是个能拿到接见的办法。他要什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#216.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#217.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#217.dst: [{~} 绿宝石块]？那很多吗？我又不是人类，你知道吧！好啦，总之！
The Feathers Fly Part II#217.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#218.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#218.dst: 你想买就买吧，不过我确定还有其他办法能拿到接见。你不是非买不可。
The Feathers Fly Part II#218.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#219.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#219.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#220.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#220.dst: 哎呀谢谢你！跟你做生意真愉快，嘿嘿……祝你好运！
The Feathers Fly Part II#220.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#222.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#222.dst: 说真的，你们这些人到底怎么回事！就不能让我清静五分钟吗？！
The Feathers Fly Part II#222.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#223.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#223.dst: 哦不好——意思，是有人叫你来这里的吗？你要来“惊艳”我吗？
The Feathers Fly Part II#223.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#224.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#224.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#225.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#225.dst: 等你真的有什么有意思的东西再来吧。再见。
The Feathers Fly Part II#225.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#226.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#226.dst: 哦？你除了找到那个贩子，还找到另一个争取接见的办法？
The Feathers Fly Part II#226.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#227.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#227.dst: [{~} 绿宝石块]，是吗？不知道那算不算多。我觉得我们该试试你说的另一条路！是什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#227.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#228.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#228.dst: 有专门负责接见的接待员？真方便！那我们该去找她谈谈！
The Feathers Fly Part II#228.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#229.src: It's difficult to get an audience? Well, it's worth a try, right? Maybe they'll see me as a wealthy lad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.dst: 接见很难争取？嗯，试试也值得，对吧？说不定他们会把我当成有钱人！
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#230.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#230.dst: 你想跟那个怪贩子买也行，不过我们也该去见见那个接待员。想要我跟你一起去就说一声。
The Feathers Fly Part II#230.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#231.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#231.dst: 好，那我们走吧。我觉得我们该避开那个贩子，我绝对不想跟法律作对！
The Feathers Fly Part II#231.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#232.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#232.dst: 所以，那个贩子就在里面，是吧？我们继续往前走吧。避开那个地方。
The Feathers Fly Part II#232.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#233.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#233.dst: 等等等等，我刚才不是才跟你说——我就缩小一点……
The Feathers Fly Part II#233.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#234.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#234.dst: 欸，[{~} 绿宝石块]，一分都不能少！别担心，我可以让你们两个都拿到接见！你女伴挺害羞的嘛！相信我，我懂你的辛苦！
The Feathers Fly Part II#234.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#235.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#235.dst: 哎呀谢谢你！跟你做生意真愉快，嘿嘿……祝你好运！
The Feathers Fly Part II#235.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#238.src: Why hello there! Greetings! Welcome! You are looking splendid, dear!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.dst: 哎呀你好！欢迎！欢迎光临！你看起来光彩照人，亲爱的！
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#239.src: Oh?! T-thank you... That's the first time someone told me such a thing!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.dst: 噢？！谢、谢谢你……这是第一次有人这样说我！
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#240.src: Don't be silly dear, you're beautiful! Say, you're looking to be an investor, am I right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.dst: 别傻了亲爱的，你很美！对了，你是来当投资人的吧，我说得对吗？
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#241.src: ...Will that grant me an audience with the Council?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.dst: ……那样能让我得到议会接见吗？
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#242.src: Why of course! Is that other person your assistant? Great!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.dst: 那当然！那位是你的助理吗？太好了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#243.src: I'd like you to show me you have what it takes to be a great investor, yes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.dst: 我希望你向我证明你有成为出色投资人的本事，没错！
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#244.src: Just hand over a mere [{~} Liquified Emeralds] and it's settled!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.dst: 只要交出区区 [{~} 液态绿宝石]，这件事就成了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#245.src: I- We'll... see what we can do.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#246.src: Look, I'm not good at being a human but even I know this is an absurd amount of money!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.dst: 听着，我虽然不擅长当人类，但连我都知道这是一笔荒唐的巨款！
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#247.src: Do you think she'd actually take it? I'm not sure. We might have to find another way...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.dst: 你觉得她真的会收吗？我不确定。我们可能得另想办法……
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#248.src: I'll go back to the town center. It's up to you if you want to risk all that money, if you even have it! We'll figure something else out.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.dst: 我回市中心那边。要不要冒险拿那么多钱出来由你决定，前提是你真的有！我们会想出别的办法。
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#249.src: Oh, you're back! With the money I see! Surprising! I like you two!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.dst: 哦，你们回来了！还带着钱！真意外！我喜欢你们两个！
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#250.src: What? Of course I'm not taking the money! I just wanted to know if you had what it takes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.dst: 什么？我当然不会收钱！我只是想知道你们有没有那个本事！
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#251.src: Now I'm sure you're not a scam. Let me see when the council's available...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.dst: 现在我确定你们不是骗子了。我看看议会什么时候有空……
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#252.src: Thanks! I'll try not to disappoint you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.dst: 谢谢！我会尽量不让你失望。
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#253.src: You are two lucky people! We do have a free spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.dst: 你们两个真幸运！我们正好有空档！
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#254.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you! We'll see you there then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.dst: 希望明天早上你们方便！到时候见！
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#256.src: That's crazy! [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? Is that how the world works?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.dst: 太疯狂了！[{~} 液态绿宝石]？这个世界就是这样运作的吗？
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#257.src: It's just... I honestly don't care about listening to the law anymore.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.dst: 只是……我真的已经不在乎守不守法了。
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#258.src: Let's just get that audience. For one, there's some girl panicking by the Armour Merchant! Maybe she could help?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.dst: 我们就去拿到那个接见吧。首先，防具商人那边有个女孩在慌张！也许她能帮上忙？
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#259.src: As for another way, I don't know if you paid attention on our way to the receptionist, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.dst: 至于另一个办法，我不知道你去接待员那里的路上有没有注意到，不过……
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#260.src: There is apparently a dealer in there. He does charge money too, though. But surely not as much as that... wretched... lady! ...Sorry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.dst: 据说那里面有个贩子。他也收钱就是了。不过肯定不会像那个……可恶的……女人那么多！……抱歉。
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#261.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#261.dst: 我相信我们能找到免费的办法。就靠你了！想要我跟你一起去就说一声！
The Feathers Fly Part II#261.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#262.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#262.dst: 希望这次能成功。你带路，我跟着！
The Feathers Fly Part II#262.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#263.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#263.dst: 哦，拜托别在我面前提“接见”这个词！
The Feathers Fly Part II#263.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#264.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#264.dst: 我、我的邀请函刚被偷了！真不敢相信！
The Feathers Fly Part II#264.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#265.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#265.dst: 我四处问过了，显然没人知道任何事！我正在找……
The Feathers Fly Part II#265.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#266.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#266.dst: 这间旅馆已经整修好一阵子了……是藏赃物的好地方！
The Feathers Fly Part II#266.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#267.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#267.dst: 可是不——，当然锁起来了！不过看起来可以从后面进去……
The Feathers Fly Part II#267.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#268.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#268.dst: 那边好像有条可疑的小巷……也许……
The Feathers Fly Part II#268.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#269.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#269.dst: 呃，抱歉唠叨这么多。我根本不认识你。我相信那边有条通道……
The Feathers Fly Part II#269.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#270.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're onto something but I'd rather not do anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around at the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#270.dst: 等等等等，我相信你发现了什么，不过我不想在城里做什么可疑的事。你想怎么做随你，我会在市中心附近晃。
The Feathers Fly Part II#270.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#278.dst: 等等等等，我相信你发现了什么，不过我不想在城里做什么可疑的事。你想怎么做随你，我会在市中心附近晃。
The Feathers Fly Part II#278.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#279.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#279.dst: 希望这次能成功。你带路，我跟着！
The Feathers Fly Part II#279.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#280.src: Oh! Why hello there you two! How may I be of assistance?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.dst: 哦！哎呀你们好！有什么能为你们效劳的？
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#281.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#281.dst: 哦，呃，你好！我们有东西要给你！
The Feathers Fly Part II#281.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#282.src: You're looking splendid dear! Now, are you-- Wait, you have a letter?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.dst: 你看起来光彩照人，亲爱的！那么，你们是——等等，你们有信？
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#283.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#283.dst: 这……前所未有。我查查议会什么时候有空，帮你们预约接见……
The Feathers Fly Part II#283.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#284.src: You two are extremely lucky. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#284.dst: 你们两个运气好得不得了。我简直不敢相信。
The Feathers Fly Part II#284.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#285.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#285.dst: 希望明天早上你们方便，因为议会不知道为什么刚好那时候有空。
The Feathers Fly Part II#285.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#286.src: You know miss, you look like you could've been a great investor. Oh well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.dst: 你知道吗小姐，你看起来本来可以是个很出色的投资人。算了，祝你们好运！
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#287.src: If you want a tip, well... There's a new guy in the Council, so he might be easier to impress!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.dst: 如果你们想要个建议，嗯……议会里有个新人，他可能比较容易被打动！
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#288.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#288.dst: 真不敢相信我们真的有进展了！太令人兴奋了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#288.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#289.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#289.dst: 好，接见之前我们得先测试一下机器。我做了些调整！
The Feathers Fly Part II#289.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#290.src: Meet me near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just go by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#290.dst: 想搭便车就到北边入口附近找我。或者，如果你喜欢走路，也可以直接去工坊！
The Feathers Fly Part II#290.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#294.dst: 哦，嘿！我打听到一些东西了！！
The Feathers Fly Part II#294.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#295.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#295.dst: 好，这不太合法，但是据说……
The Feathers Fly Part II#295.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#296.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#296.dst: 有个……可疑的贩子，可以跟他买接见邀请函？
The Feathers Fly Part II#296.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#297.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#297.dst: 我相信还有别的办法，不过那家伙应该在东边的城堡里，左手边第一扇门。
The Feathers Fly Part II#297.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#298.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#298.dst: 你自己看着办吧。我想我就……继续打听。
The Feathers Fly Part II#298.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#299.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#299.dst: 接见？哦，原来你也是那种人……
The Feathers Fly Part II#299.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#300.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#300.dst: 对对，穿过那边那座城堡，就能找到接待员。
The Feathers Fly Part II#300.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#301.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#301.dst: 你拿到的机会可是微乎其微。从别人手上偷邀请函还比较有希望，嘿！
The Feathers Fly Part II#301.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#302.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#302.dst: 说到这个……我想一个小时前城的另一头还真发生过这种事。
The Feathers Fly Part II#302.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#303.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#303.dst: 也许你可以帮帮那个弄丢邀请函的人。也许你可以把它偷来。我又管不着你！好了，快走！别踩到我的植物！
The Feathers Fly Part II#303.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#305.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#305.dst: 我是说，对，谁都可以试着争取……
The Feathers Fly Part II#305.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#306.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#306.dst: 不过你得非常出色才行。我是说，我不想刻薄，但你不够格。
The Feathers Fly Part II#306.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#307.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#307.dst: 如果你真的想去，接待员在城堡里。一直往东走别停。
The Feathers Fly Part II#307.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#308.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#308.dst: 不过我跟你说，那么多疯疯癫癫的家伙跑进去，她的心情从来没好过。
The Feathers Fly Part II#308.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#309.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#309.dst: 哦，你好。在找什么？……接见？什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#309.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#310.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#310.dst: 呃……让我猜猜你的机器是什么。是武器吗？它射什么？沙子？
The Feathers Fly Part II#310.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#311.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#311.dst: 抱歉，只是有点烦。如果你真的想要接见，有个接待员专门负责。
The Feathers Fly Part II#311.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#312.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#312.dst: 问问别人吧。这种事找我没用。
The Feathers Fly Part II#312.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#313.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#313.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#314.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#314.dst: 我一直在打造世界上最伟大的机器人化剑！
The Feathers Fly Part II#314.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#315.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#315.dst: 听着，你得去找接待员，把她惊艳得不得了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#315.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#316.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#316.dst: 太棒了！最坏的情况你会死，但只要运气够好，就只会断一条手臂！
The Feathers Fly Part II#316.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#317.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#317.dst: 她在东边的城堡里，一直穿过去往前走，总会走到的！
The Feathers Fly Part II#317.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#318.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#318.dst: 嘿，怎么了？我确实打听到一些东西！
The Feathers Fly Part II#318.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#319.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#319.dst: 嗯……所以我们可以去找接待员，她也许会给我们接见机会。明白了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#319.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#320.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#320.dst: 所以我们进去，让她看看我们有多厉害，我想这样就行了，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part II#320.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#321.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#321.dst: 没关系，我相信你只要让她看到你的决心之类的就行。
The Feathers Fly Part II#321.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#322.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#322.dst: 哦，对，我也打听到一些东西！
The Feathers Fly Part II#322.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#323.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#323.dst: 据说有个可疑的家伙在卖接见邀请函！
The Feathers Fly Part II#323.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#324.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#324.dst: 我记得是在东边的城堡里，左手边第一个？不过……
The Feathers Fly Part II#324.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#325.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#325.dst: 我相信还有别的办法。比如那个接待员！所以她在城堡最里面的房间，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part II#325.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#326.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#326.dst: 其实，如果你想要我跟你一起去，我也可以！跟我说一声就好！
The Feathers Fly Part II#326.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#328.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#328.dst: 嘿小鬼。接见，是吧？嘿嘿嘿……我倒是有个主意……
The Feathers Fly Part II#328.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#329.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#329.dst: 你知道吗，要拿到接见很难……超——级难……不过我知道一个办法。
The Feathers Fly Part II#329.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#330.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#330.dst: 真的很简单很简单……你只要交给我 [{~} 绿宝石块]，我就帮你搞定！
The Feathers Fly Part II#330.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#331.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#331.dst: ……嘿嘿嘿……好吧，要是你有意思，你知道上哪找我！
The Feathers Fly Part II#331.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#332.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#332.dst: 所以你找到那个怪贩子了？你该不会在想……
The Feathers Fly Part II#332.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#333.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#333.dst: 我是说……其实，那确实是个能拿到接见的办法。他要什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#333.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#334.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#334.dst: [{~} 绿宝石块]？那很多吗？我又不是人类，你知道吧！好啦，总之！
The Feathers Fly Part II#334.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#335.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#335.dst: 你想买就买吧，不过我确定还有其他办法能拿到接见。你不是非买不可。
The Feathers Fly Part II#335.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#336.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#336.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#337.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#337.dst: 哎呀谢谢你！跟你做生意真愉快，嘿嘿……祝你好运！
The Feathers Fly Part II#337.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#339.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#339.dst: 说真的，你们这些人到底怎么回事！就不能让我清静五分钟吗？！
The Feathers Fly Part II#339.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#340.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#340.dst: 哦不好——意思，是有人叫你来这里的吗？你要来“惊艳”我吗？
The Feathers Fly Part II#340.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#341.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#341.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#342.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#342.dst: 等你真的有什么有意思的东西再来吧。再见。
The Feathers Fly Part II#342.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#343.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#343.dst: 哦？你除了找到那个贩子，还找到另一个争取接见的办法？
The Feathers Fly Part II#343.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#344.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#344.dst: [{~} 绿宝石块]，是吗？不知道那算不算多。我觉得我们该试试你说的另一条路！是什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#344.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#345.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#345.dst: 有专门负责接见的接待员？真方便！那我们该去找她谈谈！
The Feathers Fly Part II#345.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#346.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Huh. Well, we should still give it a go? I look fancy, surely they'll listen!
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.dst: 这……据说非常难？咦。嗯，我们还是该试试吧？我穿得这么体面，他们肯定会听！
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#347.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#347.dst: 你想跟那个怪贩子买也行，不过我们也该去见见那个接待员。想要我跟你一起去就说一声。
The Feathers Fly Part II#347.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#348.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#348.dst: 好，那我们走吧。我觉得我们该避开那个贩子，我绝对不想跟法律作对！
The Feathers Fly Part II#348.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#349.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#349.dst: 所以，那个贩子就在里面，是吧？我们继续往前走吧。避开那个地方。
The Feathers Fly Part II#349.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#350.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#350.dst: 等等等等，我刚才不是才跟你说——我就缩小一点……
The Feathers Fly Part II#350.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#351.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#351.dst: 欸，[{~} 绿宝石块]，一分都不能少！别担心，我可以让你们两个都拿到接见！你女伴挺害羞的嘛！相信我，我懂你的辛苦！
The Feathers Fly Part II#351.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#352.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#352.dst: 哎呀谢谢你！跟你做生意真愉快，嘿嘿……祝你好运！
The Feathers Fly Part II#352.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#355.src: And just WHO are you two, busting here like that?
The Feathers Fly Part II#355.dst: 你们两个到底是谁，就这样闯进来？
The Feathers Fly Part II#355.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#356.src: Uh... Greetings... We've heard that we should come here for-
The Feathers Fly Part II#356.dst: 呃……你好……我们听说应该来这里——
The Feathers Fly Part II#356.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#357.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? I need more than fancy clothes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.dst: 你们有任何东西可以展示吗？我要的不只是华丽的衣服。
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#358.src: Oh, uh, we, well I actually made a, uh, what's it called, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.dst: 哦，呃，我们，嗯，其实我做了一台，呃，那个叫什么来着，呃……
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#359.src: Not Another word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.dst: 别再说了！我听够了！你们两个显然没有值得我花时间的东西！
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#360.src: And what's up with your face, lady? I'd look into that if I were you! OUT!
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.dst: 还有你的脸是怎么回事，女士？我要是你就去看看！出去！
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#361.src: The citizens said it was hard, huh? No kidding. Maybe we should've had something before strolling in.
The Feathers Fly Part II#361.dst: 市民们说很难，是吧？可不是嘛。也许我们该先准备好东西再晃进去。
The Feathers Fly Part II#361.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#362.src: Look, we'll figure out another approach. This can't end here! We need an audience invitation letter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#362.dst: 听着，我们会想出别的办法。不能就这样结束！我们需要一封接见邀请函。
The Feathers Fly Part II#362.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#363.src: I'll head back to the town center, so if you want to talk I'll see ya there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#363.dst: 我回市中心那边，所以如果你想聊，我们那里见！
The Feathers Fly Part II#363.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#364.src: That certainly didn't go well. But keep your head up! We got this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#364.dst: 那确实不太顺利。不过打起精神！我们做得到！
The Feathers Fly Part II#364.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#365.src: There was a normal way to get an audience which is via a competition. We... missed it. So that'll have to pass.
The Feathers Fly Part II#365.dst: 原本有个正规的争取接见途径，就是参加比赛。我们……错过了。所以那个只能放弃了。
The Feathers Fly Part II#365.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#366.src: Now, for other... Unconventional ways... There was some panic by the Armour Merchant earlier today.
The Feathers Fly Part II#366.dst: 至于其他……比较不正规的办法……今天稍早防具商人那边有人在慌张。
The Feathers Fly Part II#366.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#367.src: Maybe that's our ticket? I don't know, I'm just a law-abiding citizen. Well, actually, about that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.dst: 也许那就是我们的门路？我不知道，我只是个守法的市民。嗯，其实，说到这个……
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#368.src: There is apparently a dealer in the castle the receptionist's in, first entrance to the left. However, he charges emeralds...
The Feathers Fly Part II#368.dst: 据说接待员所在的那座城堡里有个贩子，左手边第一个入口。不过，他要收绿宝石……
The Feathers Fly Part II#368.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#369.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#369.dst: 我相信我们能找到免费的办法。就靠你了！想要我跟你一起去就说一声！
The Feathers Fly Part II#369.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#370.src: Let's hope we don't get rejected this time around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#370.dst: 希望这次别再被拒绝了。
The Feathers Fly Part II#370.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#371.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#371.dst: 哦，拜托别在我面前提“接见”这个词！
The Feathers Fly Part II#371.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#372.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#372.dst: 我、我的邀请函刚被偷了！真不敢相信！
The Feathers Fly Part II#372.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#373.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#373.dst: 我四处问过了，显然没人知道任何事！我正在找……
The Feathers Fly Part II#373.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#374.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#374.dst: 这间旅馆已经整修好一阵子了……是藏赃物的好地方！
The Feathers Fly Part II#374.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#375.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#375.dst: 可是不——，当然锁起来了！不过看起来可以从后面进去……
The Feathers Fly Part II#375.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#376.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#376.dst: 那边好像有条可疑的小巷……也许……
The Feathers Fly Part II#376.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#377.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#377.dst: 呃，抱歉唠叨这么多。我根本不认识你。我相信那边有条通道……
The Feathers Fly Part II#377.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#378.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're on to something but I'd rather not to anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around in the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#378.dst: 等等等等，我相信你发现了什么，不过我不想在城里做什么可疑的事。你想怎么做随你，我会在市中心附近晃。
The Feathers Fly Part II#378.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#379.src: Leaving town? I'll stick around, just come back eventually, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.dst: 要离开城里？我会留在附近，你之后记得回来，好吗？
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#388.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#388.dst: 所以，那个贩子就在里面，是吧？我们继续往前走吧。避开那个地方。
The Feathers Fly Part II#388.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#389.src: Oh god, not another duo. What do you want?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#389.dst: 天啊，又来一对。你们想干嘛？！
The Feathers Fly Part II#389.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#390.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#390.dst: 哦，呃，你好！我们有东西要给你！
The Feathers Fly Part II#390.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#391.src: Why sure darling, you have {~} seconds to- Hold on, that letter...
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.dst: 当然了亲爱的，你有 {~} 秒可以——等等，那封信……
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#392.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#392.dst: 这……前所未有。我查查议会什么时候有空，帮你们预约接见……
The Feathers Fly Part II#392.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#393.src: You two are extremely luck. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.dst: 你们两个运气好得不得了。我简直不敢相信。
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#394.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#394.dst: 希望明天早上你们方便，因为议会不知道为什么刚好那时候有空。
The Feathers Fly Part II#394.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#395.src: Don't miss it. Oh, and miss, there's something really off about your face.
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.dst: 别错过了。哦，还有小姐，你的脸真的有点不对劲。
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#396.src: Thank you so much! Sorry about my face, I'm... New in town. Bye!
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.dst: 太谢谢你了！抱歉我的脸，我……刚来城里。再见！
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#397.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#397.dst: 真不敢相信我们真的有进展了！太令人兴奋了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#397.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#398.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#398.dst: 好，接见之前我们得先测试一下机器。我做了些调整！
The Feathers Fly Part II#398.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#399.src: Meet me near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just go by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#399.dst: 想搭便车就到北边入口附近找我。或者，如果你喜欢走路，也可以直接去工坊！
The Feathers Fly Part II#399.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#400.src: Urgh, what now? You better be quick.
The Feathers Fly Part II#400.dst: 呃，又怎么了？你最好快点。
The Feathers Fly Part II#400.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#401.src: Wait you... You actually have an invitation letter? ...How...
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.dst: 等等你……你真的有邀请函？……怎么会……
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#402.src: Wait, WHY do you have TWO letters?? This doesn't make any sense?! Oh well, whatever I'm not paid enough to care.
The Feathers Fly Part II#402.dst: 等等，你为什么有“两封”信？？这完全说不通？！算了，随便，他们付我的钱不够让我在乎。
The Feathers Fly Part II#402.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#403.src: Oh, wow, you're not gonna believe this. You're a lucky one. Are you alone? No?
The Feathers Fly Part II#403.dst: 哦，哇，你一定不敢相信。你真走运。你是一个人吗？不是？
The Feathers Fly Part II#403.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#404.src: Well, I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time
The Feathers Fly Part II#404.dst: 嗯，希望明天早上你方便，因为议会不知道为什么刚好那时候有空
The Feathers Fly Part II#404.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#405.src: Sounds good? Well. go tell your partner about this you are two lucky Corkians!
The Feathers Fly Part II#405.dst: 可以吗？好。去跟你的伙伴说这件事吧，你们是两个幸运的 Corkus 人！
The Feathers Fly Part II#405.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#406.dst: 哦，嘿！我打听到一些东西了！！
The Feathers Fly Part II#406.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#407.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#407.dst: 好，这不太合法，但是据说……
The Feathers Fly Part II#407.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#408.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#408.dst: 有个……可疑的贩子，可以跟他买接见邀请函？
The Feathers Fly Part II#408.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#409.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#409.dst: 我相信还有别的办法，不过那家伙应该在东边的城堡里，左手边第一扇门。
The Feathers Fly Part II#409.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#410.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#410.dst: 你自己看着办吧。我想我就……继续打听。
The Feathers Fly Part II#410.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#411.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#411.dst: 接见？哦，原来你也是那种人……
The Feathers Fly Part II#411.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#412.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#412.dst: 对对，穿过那边那座城堡，就能找到接待员。
The Feathers Fly Part II#412.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#413.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#413.dst: 你拿到的机会可是微乎其微。从别人手上偷邀请函还比较有希望，嘿！
The Feathers Fly Part II#413.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#414.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#414.dst: 说到这个……我想一个小时前城的另一头还真发生过这种事。
The Feathers Fly Part II#414.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#415.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#415.dst: 也许你可以帮帮那个弄丢邀请函的人。也许你可以把它偷来。我又管不着你！好了，快走！别踩到我的植物！
The Feathers Fly Part II#415.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#417.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#417.dst: 我是说，对，谁都可以试着争取……
The Feathers Fly Part II#417.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#418.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#418.dst: 不过你得非常出色才行。我是说，我不想刻薄，但你不够格。
The Feathers Fly Part II#418.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#419.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#419.dst: 如果你真的想去，接待员在城堡里。一直往东走别停。
The Feathers Fly Part II#419.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#420.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#420.dst: 不过我跟你说，那么多疯疯癫癫的家伙跑进去，她的心情从来没好过。
The Feathers Fly Part II#420.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#421.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#421.dst: 哦，你好。在找什么？……接见？什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#421.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#422.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#422.dst: 呃……让我猜猜你的机器是什么。是武器吗？它射什么？沙子？
The Feathers Fly Part II#422.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#423.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#423.dst: 抱歉，只是有点烦。如果你真的想要接见，有个接待员专门负责。
The Feathers Fly Part II#423.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#424.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#424.dst: 问问别人吧。这种事找我没用。
The Feathers Fly Part II#424.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#425.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#425.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#426.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#426.dst: 我一直在打造世界上最伟大的机器人化剑！
The Feathers Fly Part II#426.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#427.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#427.dst: 听着，你得去找接待员，把她惊艳得不得了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#427.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#428.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#428.dst: 太棒了！最坏的情况你会死，但只要运气够好，就只会断一条手臂！
The Feathers Fly Part II#428.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#429.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#429.dst: 她在东边的城堡里，一直穿过去往前走，总会走到的！
The Feathers Fly Part II#429.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#430.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#430.dst: 嘿，怎么了？我确实打听到一些东西！
The Feathers Fly Part II#430.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#431.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#431.dst: 嗯……所以我们可以去找接待员，她也许会给我们接见机会。明白了！
The Feathers Fly Part II#431.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#432.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#432.dst: 所以我们进去，让她看看我们有多厉害，我想这样就行了，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part II#432.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#433.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#433.dst: 没关系，我相信你只要让她看到你的决心之类的就行。
The Feathers Fly Part II#433.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#434.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#434.dst: 哦，对，我也打听到一些东西！
The Feathers Fly Part II#434.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#435.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#435.dst: 据说有个可疑的家伙在卖接见邀请函！
The Feathers Fly Part II#435.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#436.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#436.dst: 我记得是在东边的城堡里，左手边第一个？不过……
The Feathers Fly Part II#436.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#437.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#437.dst: 我相信还有别的办法。比如那个接待员！所以她在城堡最里面的房间，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part II#437.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#438.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#438.dst: 其实，如果你想要我跟你一起去，我也可以！跟我说一声就好！
The Feathers Fly Part II#438.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#440.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#440.dst: 嘿小鬼。接见，是吧？嘿嘿嘿……我倒是有个主意……
The Feathers Fly Part II#440.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#441.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#441.dst: 你知道吗，要拿到接见很难……超——级难……不过我知道一个办法。
The Feathers Fly Part II#441.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#442.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#442.dst: 真的很简单很简单……你只要交给我 [{~} 绿宝石块]，我就帮你搞定！
The Feathers Fly Part II#442.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#443.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#443.dst: ……嘿嘿嘿……好吧，要是你有意思，你知道上哪找我！
The Feathers Fly Part II#443.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#444.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#444.dst: 所以你找到那个怪贩子了？你该不会在想……
The Feathers Fly Part II#444.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#445.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#445.dst: 我是说……其实，那确实是个能拿到接见的办法。他要什么？
The Feathers Fly Part II#445.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#446.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#446.dst: [{~} 绿宝石块]？那很多吗？我又不是人类，你知道吧！好啦，总之！
The Feathers Fly Part II#446.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#447.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#447.dst: 你想买就买吧，不过我确定还有其他办法能拿到接见。你不是非买不可。
The Feathers Fly Part II#447.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#448.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#448.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#449.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#449.dst: 哎呀谢谢你！跟你做生意真愉快，嘿嘿……祝你好运！
The Feathers Fly Part II#449.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#451.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#451.dst: 说真的，你们这些人到底怎么回事！就不能让我清静五分钟吗？！
The Feathers Fly Part II#451.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#452.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#452.dst: 哦不好——意思，是有人叫你来这里的吗？你要来“惊艳”我吗？
The Feathers Fly Part II#452.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#453.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#453.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#454.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#454.dst: 等你真的有什么有意思的东西再来吧。再见。
The Feathers Fly Part II#454.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#455.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#455.dst: 哦？你除了找到那个贩子，还找到另一个争取接见的办法？
The Feathers Fly Part II#455.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#456.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
